# leticode.toml

<!-- generated by `letibot --config-reference --markdown leticode.toml`; do not edit -->

Location: user: $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/letibot/leticode.toml (else ~/.config/letibot); project: the nearest leticode.toml at or above the workspace

which models answer, and the session, queue, head and sandbox settings, at two levels

## `top level`

Order: command line, project file, user file, providers.toml. A key a level does not set falls through.

| key | type | default | level | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `main_model` | string | --provider, else providers.toml [default], else local | both, project wins | model the session's turns go to |
| `subagent_model` | string | the parent's model | both, project wins | default model for `task` spawns |
| `gatekeeper_model` | string | providers.toml [gatekeeper] model, else the session's | both, project wins | guard model |
| `judge_model` | string | as gatekeeper_model | both, project wins | same seat as gatekeeper_model; two different values are refused |
| `fallback` | list of models \| [fallback] table | providers.toml [fallback] models | the level that sets it replaces the other | models to move to when the session's model is out, in order |
| `fallback_after_timeouts` | int >= 1 | 3 | both, project wins | consecutive model timeouts before a fallback move |

## `[fallback]`

Table form of `fallback`: the list for one limited model. Lookup: exact model, then `provider/*`, then `*`.

| key | type | default | level | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<model>` | non-empty list | none | as fallback | list for that model; key is `provider/model`, `provider/*` or `*` |

## `[provider]`

Usage limits and model API deadlines.

| key | type | default | level | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `on_limit` | "wait" \| "switch" | switch with a fallback, else wait | both, project wins | on a usage limit: park until the reset, or move to the next fallback |
| `wait_if_within` | span (45m, 1h30m, 90s, 2d, 0) | 45m | both, project wins | with switch: a reset this close is waited for anyway; 0 never waits |
| `fallback` | list of models | none | as fallback | the top-level fallback list; both set to different lists is refused |
| `slow_notice_seconds` | int >= 1 | 15 | both, project wins | silence before the "model slow" notice |
| `first_byte_seconds` | int >= 1 | 60 | both, project wins | silence before the first byte that fails the round |
| `answer_seconds` | int >= 1 | 600 | both, project wins | budget for the whole answer |

## `[provider.<name>]`

NAME is a preset or `provider/model`. Resolves per key: model, preset, [provider], built-in.

| key | type | default | level | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `slow_notice_seconds` | int >= 1 | [provider]'s | both, project wins | as [provider], for this preset or model |
| `first_byte_seconds` | int >= 1 | [provider]'s | both, project wins | as [provider], for this preset or model |
| `answer_seconds` | int >= 1 | [provider]'s | both, project wins | as [provider], for this preset or model |

## `[roles]`

| key | type | default | level | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<name>` | string | none | both, project wins | shorthand for [roles.<name>] model |

## `[roles.<name>]`

NAME is a seat a spawn uses, or `subagent`, the floor under every spawn. Window and reply-cap keys are refused.

| key | type | default | level | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `model` | string | none | both, project wins | model this role runs on |
| `temperature` | number | 0.7 | both, project wins | sampler |
| `top_p` | number | 0.8 | both, project wins | sampler |
| `top_k` | int | 20 | both, project wins | sampler |
| `min_p` | number | 0 | both, project wins | sampler |
| `presence_penalty` | number | 1.5 | both, project wins | sampler |

## `[exec]`

| key | type | default | level | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `auto_background` | bool | true | both, project wins | move a call to the background past the threshold |
| `foreground_seconds` | int >= 1 | 60 | both, project wins | foreground threshold |
| `job_dead_after_seconds` | int | 1800 | both, project wins | a job with no output and no CPU this long is dead; 0 = check off |

## `[memory]`

Amounts: a size (64M, 2G) or a fraction of free memory (0.5, 50%). Over providers.toml [memory].

| key | type | default | level | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `default` | amount | providers.toml, else 64M | both, project wins | cap for a bash call that names none |
| `ceiling` | amount | providers.toml, else 0.5 | both, project wins | most a call may take without asking; may only narrow |

## `[boundary]`

What a command's view holds beyond the built-in list.

| key | type | default | level | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `grants_ro` | list of paths | [] | both, joined | readable in a command's view |
| `grants_rw` | list of paths | [] | user only, joined | writable in a command's view |
| `hide` | list of paths | [] | both, joined | denied after every grant |
| `firecode_only` | list of programs | [] | both, joined | programs allowed only inside firecode |

## `[boundary.env]`

| key | type | default | level | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<name>` | string | none | both, joined | constant handed to every command |

## `[perimeter.<name>]`

NAME: `top-level`, `subagent`, or a child perimeter `task` names. Lists join per NAME.

| key | type | default | level | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `grants_ro` | list of paths | [] | user only | readable |
| `grants_rw` | list of paths | [] | user only | writable |
| `hide` | list of paths | [] | both, joined | masked |
| `docker` | bool | false | user only for true; user's value first | the seat gets a docker socket under its owner root |
| `secrets` | list: github | top-level: github; others: none | user only | secrets the seat carries |

## `[perimeter.<name>.env]`

| key | type | default | level | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<name>` | string \| {file=..} \| {command=..} | none | both, joined | env value, computed outside the box |

## `[skills]`

| key | type | default | level | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `pin` | list of skills | [] | both, joined | skills kept loaded |
| `never_offer` | list of skills | [] | both, joined | skills never offered |

## `[skills.when.<name>]`

Overrides the skill's frontmatter. The user's table replaces the project's whole.

| key | type | default | level | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `requires` | list of capabilities | frontmatter | both, user wins | all must be on the seat |
| `unless` | list of capabilities | frontmatter | both, user wins | any one present hides the skill |

## `[nag]`

The idle plan-check clock.

| key | type | default | level | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `after_seconds` | int >= 1 | 60 | both, project wins | idle window before the plan-check |
| `floor_seconds` | int >= 1 | 10 | both, project wins | shortest re-arm an operator add earns |
| `repeat_cap_seconds` | int >= 1 | 1800 | both, project wins | ceiling for the doubled interval |

## `[room]`

| key | type | default | level | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `tie_breaker` | string | deepseek/deepseek-flash | both, project wins | model that arbitrates the room's items |
| `held_quiet_seconds` | int >= 1 | 600 | both, project wins | how long held room lines wait for their digest turn |

## `[queue]`

The merge queue reads the project file only, except the three census keys.

| key | type | default | level | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `stuck_after_seconds` | int >= 1 | 900 | both, project wins | a row stuck this long goes into the census |
| `stuck_repeat_seconds` | int >= 1 | 7200 | both, project wins | how often the census repeats |
| `mute` | list of repositories | [] | both, joined | repositories the session is not woken for |
| `target` | string | main, else master, else checked out | project only | branch this project lands on |
| `merge_via_session` | bool | false | project only | a review that cannot run goes to the main session |
| `red_target` | "fix" \| "raise" | fix | project only | what a red target triggers |
| `gate_carry` | list of paths | [] | project only | gitignored inputs copied into the landing tree |
| `reviewers` | "host" \| "vm" | host | project only | where reviewers run |
| `gate_host` | hosts.toml name | this machine | project only | machine the gate runs on |
| `gate_in` | "host" \| "firecode" | host | project only | gate steps run in a firecode VM |
| `reviewer_skills` | list of skills | [] | project only | skills preloaded into reviewers |
| `gate_train` | int >= 1 | 1 | project only | branches judged by one gate |
| `reviewers_at_once` | int >= 1 | placement's | project only | concurrent reviewers |
| `reviewer_hosts` | list; ["*"] = all | ["local"] | project only | hosts a host reviewer may use |

Present: this project's reviewers are `claude -p` runs.

| key | type | default | level | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `binary` | absolute path | required | project only | the `claude` executable |
| `allowed_tools` | list | built-in 7 | project only | --allowedTools |
| `permission_mode` | string | "default" | project only | --permission-mode |
| `timeout_seconds` | int >= 1 | 3600 | project only | deadline for one review |

Read by the head. NAME may not be a built-in profile (conversation, read-edits, terse, normal, loud).

| `repository` | bool | true | nearest project file, else user | false: a folder outside git does not adopt a child repository |

## `[embeddings]`

The project's table if its mode is not off, else the user's, whole.

| key | type | default | level | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | off \| internal \| http://.. | off | both, project wins | who turns text into vectors |
| `model` | string | built-in, or text-embedding-3-small over http | both, project wins | model directory or remote name |
| `download` | bool | true | both, project wins | may fetch the built-in model |
| `builtin_repo` | owner/name | shipped | both, project wins | where the built-in model comes from |
| `builtin_revision` | 40 hex | shipped | both, project wins | its commit; needs builtin_sha256 |
| `builtin_sha256` | table: file = 64 hex | shipped | both, project wins | hash per model file; needs builtin_revision |
